title: Overlay101
description: Overlay101 is a minimalist client utility that clears visual clutter by toggling armor, HUD elements, and specific particle groups. It features customizable item offsets and an independent offhand slider to create a perfectly clean and cinematic Minecraft
body:
Overlay101 is the ultimate minimalist client utility for Fabric 1.21.x, designed to strip away visual clutter and give you total control over your screen. Whether you are in a high-stakes PvP duel or building a masterpiece, this mod provides a clean, cinematic field of view without losing any core game functionality.
Take back your screen by toggling armor visibility for yourself or others, killing distracting fire and pumpkin overlays, and hiding the entire HUD for true immersion. With the precision particle filter, you can individually remove mining bits, blue XP splashes, or potion swirls to boost your FPS and clarity.
The advanced Item Offset system allows you to lower blocks, food, and combat tools independently using smooth sliders. Plus, the custom Shield Fix moves the shield in 3D space to prevent your arm from clipping through the model. With a 100% independent offhand slider, you can finally tuck your main hand gear away while keeping your totem exactly where you want it.
Requirements: Fabric API & Cloth Config. Press F6 (customizable as "Menu Bind") to open the settings instantly. 100% client-side and server-safe.
